flights.description: Iranian presidential aircraft (A340, reg EP-IGA) — used by President Pezeshkian. Flew to Muscat amid Israeli escalation and US entry speculation.
Iranian government A321. Part of 3-plane delegation to Muscat.
Iranian government A321. Part of 3-plane delegation to Muscat. Possible 4th aircraft also reported by ATC.

events.context: Iran's largest diplomatic aircraft movement of the conflict. 3 government planes to Muscat came days before US directly entered the war. Widely interpreted as Iran seeking a negotiated off-ramp via Oman.

flights.description: US negotiating team including envoy Steve Witkoff flew to Muscat for first round of indirect US-Iran nuclear talks.
Iranian delegation including FM Araghchi flew to Muscat. Indirect talks mediated by Omani FM Badr Al Busaidi.

events.context: Round 1 of indirect US-Iran nuclear talks. Iran FM Araghchi said talks were 'a very good start' but 'over for now'. US carrier strike group USS Abraham Lincoln in Arabian Sea during talks.

flights.description: US delegation flew to Geneva for 2nd round of indirect nuclear talks at Oman ambassador's residence.
Iranian delegation to Geneva for 2nd round. FM Araghchi reported 'good progress' on guiding principles.

events.context: Round 2 of indirect talks, Geneva. FM Araghchi reported 'good progress' on guiding principles but core demands irreconcilable — US demanded zero enrichment on Iranian soil, Iran refused categorically.

flights.description: US delegation to Geneva. Talks paused mid-session as American negotiators met a Ukrainian delegation.
Iranian delegation. FM Araghchi stated a 'historic' agreement was 'within reach' — talks held morning and evening.

events.context: Round 3 of indirect talks at Oman's UN Geneva residence. FM Araghchi said historic deal 'within reach'. Talks paused for US-Ukraine meeting. Last diplomatic round before military preparations overtook the process.

flights.description: SecState Rubio's scheduled flight to Israel for Netanyahu meeting — CANCELLED. Operation began instead.

events.context: Rubio's Israel meeting never happened — US-Israel launched major combat operations against Iran on Feb 28 instead. Diplomatic track expired entirely.

flights.description: Pakistan Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir and PM Shehbaz Sharif conducting phone diplomacy with Iran's Pezeshkian. In-person Islamabad meeting being organized.

events.context: Islamabad emerging as venue for possible direct US-Iran talks within Trump's 5-day pause window. Israeli official confirmed 'contacts are underway'. JD Vance floated as US representative. No confirmed flight yet — tracker watching.
